column3: internal/credit/credit.go BalanceFor sums journal_entries on ledger.AccountCredit per currency, served to the customer by handlePortalCredits in internal/httpapi/credits.go.

credit.Service.StartDeposit in internal/credit/deposit.go enforces credits.minimum_deposit_minor and maximum_deposit_minor, creates a snapshot-marked deposit invoice and opens a gateway session via POST /api/v1/portal/credits/deposit.

credit.ApplyCreditToInvoice is called only from internal/register/checkout.go, so auto-use does not run on renewal (internal/renewal/renewal.go), upgrade (internal/service/upgrades.go) or manual (internal/httpapi/staff_write.go) issuance.
credit.ApplyCredit in internal/credit/apply.go spends min(owed, balance) and leaves the invoice open, and checkout.Service.Start prices the remainder as total_minor minus amount_paid_minor.
internal/credit/deposit.go refuses a top-up over credits.maximum_credit_minor counting open deposit invoices as reservation, and SettleDeposit reports OverLimit when a settlement overshoots.
internal/service/upgrades.go records a prorated CreditMinor with CreditPending on a service_upgrades row and Store.ApplyDowngrade is the credit hook, but nothing posts that credit to customer_credit.

credit.Grant issues a numbered credit note (internal/credit/grant.go) and credit.Debit (internal/credit/debit.go) appends a credit_debit entry with a mandatory reason, behind POST /api/v1/staff/customers/{id}/credit and /credit/debit.
web/src/views/portal-credits.ts is routed at /portal/credits in web/src/routes.ts and shows derived balances, GET /api/v1/portal/credits/transactions history and a deposit form.

internal/credit/TransactionsFor joins journal_transactions.kind so entries read as credit_debit, adjustment or payment_received, with ledger.RefCreditApplication, RefCreditDeposit and RefCreditGrant distinguishing the events.
internal/settings/settings.go declares credits.enabled, minimum_deposit_minor, maximum_deposit_minor, maximum_credit_minor and auto_use, but there is no credit-on-downgrade key.
invoices_status_check plus the transition table rebuilt in internal/store/migrations/0021_proforma.sql allow draft to open to paid, void, uncollectible, refunded and disputed.
invoice_lines in 0001_core.sql carries position, description, quantity, unit, net, tax and total, and 0019_invoice_line_product.sql adds product_id and price_version_id for the service reference.

invoicepdf.LoadNumbering and seriesPrefix support a configured prefix, padding and {year}/{month}/{day} tokens, but issuance sites still pass billing.DefaultSeries so only proforma conversion honours them.

invoicepdf.IssueProforma and ConvertProforma with 0021_proforma.sql convert once, called from internal/fulfilment/applier.go inside the settling transaction so a paid document cannot stay provisional.

guard_issued_invoice in internal/store/migrations/0021_proforma.sql freezes number, currency, money, snapshot, customer, order and period once issued, but client_note, void_reason, due_at and amount_paid_minor remain writable.
billing.Issuer.CreateDraft writes billing.Snapshot with merchant, customer, prices, totals and TaxEvidence, frozen by the 0021 trigger and reprinted by invoicepdf.FromInvoice.

invoices.client_note is written by handleSetClientNote and billing_profiles.bill_to_text is read in internal/httpapi/invoice_pdf.go, both printed via invoicepdf.Meta under invoices.notes_client_visible.

handlePortalInvoicePDF and handleStaffInvoicePDF in internal/httpapi/invoice_pdf.go serve invoicepdf.Render bytes to the customer and to staff, with the portal link in web/src/views/portal-invoice.ts.
handleVoidWithReason in internal/httpapi/invoice_documents.go stores invoices.void_reason in the same UPDATE as the status, and invoicepdf prints it beside the void banner.
credit_notes (0012_money_actions.sql) are issued with CN- numbers by creditnote.Issue, but there are no debit notes and creditnote.StatusVoid is never written by any code path.
handlePortalInvoiceDocument and portalInvoiceCreditNotes in internal/httpapi/invoice_documents.go list every credit note to its customer with a working portal credit-note PDF route, unconditionally.
internal/httpapi/staff_read.go reports due as total_minor minus amount_paid_minor and internal/httpapi/export.go emits balance_due_minor, both derived from payments and their allocations.
handleStaffInvoices in internal/httpapi/staff_read.go filters status, customer_id, currency, from, to and overdue, and web/src/views/invoices.ts filters nothing in the browser.
POST /api/v1/staff/invoices/{id}/issue publishes a draft and always queues the customer mail through queueInvoiceNotification in internal/httpapi/staff_write.go, so there is no per-issue send toggle.
internal/invoicepdf/document.go renders one fixed layout with an invoicepdf.Brand overlay (accent, logo, name) sourced from internal/brand, and there is no per-theme PDF template.
internal/dunning/dunning.go only reminds after the due date using DefaultPolicy (48h interval, three steps) with no pre-due reminder and no settings key for the schedule.

invoices.due_days defaults to 7 and is read by the proforma handler in internal/httpapi/invoice_documents.go, but manual invoice create (internal/httpapi/staff_write.go) and checkout (internal/register/checkout.go) hardcode 30 days.

invoices.credit_note_prefix and credit_note_padding are declared in internal/settings/settings.go and parsed by invoicepdf.LoadNumbering, yet creditnote.CreditSeries and credit.CreditSeries stay hardcoded to CN- and width 6.
